title: assure ledger
description: Prints the proof ledger for a commit from verified attestations and the spec in the git objects of the checkout that holds the working folder: one line per test record in ID order with its state, its result at the commit (passed, failed, skipped or none) and the last commit a verified proof run passed it at, or not within the commits walked; then the release-grade proof run at the commit with its signer and log entry, or why there is none; then each change-grade attestation at a commit walked, as change grade at <ref>: counts only in its own gate; then each attestation refused at a commit walked, with the verifier's reason; then the test records that did not pass. Only a release-grade proof run, signed at main, gives results and last passes: the ledger is for anyone with no gate's context, so it reads no change ref and takes no base, and a change-grade attestation gives no result. It walks the first-parent history from the commit, at most --depth commits (200 by default), and stops when every automated test record has passed somewhere, so a test record in another state can show not within the commits walked although an older proof run within the depth passed it. Reads the trusted signer, the API and the token from the environment. It runs no Lathe. Exits 0 when a release-grade proof run at the commit passed every automated test record, 1 when any did not or there is no such proof run, and 2, with no ledger, when called wrongly or when the ledger cannot be built, such as when the commit has no spec or the provider's store cannot answer. With go run -C cmd/assure, a relative path in a flag is read from cmd/assure, not from the root of the checkout: give each path absolute.

title: stego build verify
description: stego build verify checks an executable against a trusted record.

title: stego build verify-source
description: stego build verify-source checks a source snapshot against a trusted record.

title: stego image verify
description: stego image verify checks a local image; stego image retrieve checks one from a registry.

title: stego validate
description: stego validate checks the declaration and prints every fault, or that there is none. It has no structured output yet.

title: stego fleet
description: Not written yet: stego fleet -digest <digest> <checkout>... will name every service that pins the digest.

title: stego version
description: stego version prints the version; with its one flag it prints the version and the build identity as structured output.

title: stego fleet measures
description: Not written yet: stego fleet measures <checkout>... will sweep the checkouts and print each outcome measure with the services behind it, as text, or with its one flag as structured output.

title: stego fleet vex
description: Not written yet: stego fleet vex <checkout>... will sweep the checkouts and print one OpenVEX statement per service and advisory.

title: stego env check
description: stego env check reports every platform requirement an environment file does not meet, and exits non-zero when one is unmet. Planned.

title: stego registry fills
description: stego registry fills lists the project's fills for a slot.

title: stego fill status
description: Not written yet: stego fill status will list the qualification of each bound fill.

title: stego drift
description: stego drift prints every drifted file and input, and fails when there is any.

title: stego plan
description: stego plan makes a plan and prints the action for each generated file. Today it saves nothing, so apply plans again.

title: stego registry inspect
description: stego registry inspect <component> prints one component's version, namespace, ports, slots and settings as text.

title: stego registry search
description: stego registry search [-provides <port>] [-requires <port>] [-slot <slot>] prints the matching components, one to a line.

title: stego registry sunsets
description: Not written yet: stego registry sunsets <checkout>... will list every recorded service that uses a component past its sunset without a dated acceptance, and exit non-zero when there is any.

title: stego registry quality
description: Not written yet: stego registry quality will print each ga component's standing against the quality bar and the share that hold it, and exit non-zero when the share is below 100%.
